key_insight: Rennala NSGD extends stochastic optimization beyond Euclidean geometry, with high-probability guarantees that explicitly track the dual space’s regularity constant κ.
engineering_relevance: The framework provides theoretical guidance for geometry-aware optimization on heterogeneous workers, motivated by matrix-aware methods used in deep learning.
method: Analyze minibatch SGD for smooth nonconvex objectives under arbitrary finite-dimensional norms.
Use κ-regularity and a dual-norm light-tail noise condition to bound oracle complexity.
Introduce semi-asynchronous Rennala NSGD with wall-clock guarantees for fixed, heterogeneous worker computation times.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical bounds rather than empirical benchmarks: Euclidean rates are recovered up to logarithmic factors, while some non-Euclidean settings reduce linear dimension dependence to logarithmic dependence.
watch_item: Practical gains depend on the geometry and noise model; the wall-clock analysis assumes fixed worker computation times.
paper_title: Rennala NSGD: Asynchronous Stochastic Optimization Beyond Euclidean Geometry
